title: 8.3 Proving Triangle Similarity by SSS and SAS

icans: I can compare the ratios of corresponding sides to decide whether two triangles are similar (SSS).
I can use an included angle and two proportional sides to show two triangles are similar (SAS).
I can find the value of a variable that makes two triangles similar.

vocab: if the ________________ side lengths of two triangles are proportional, the triangles are similar
if an angle of one triangle is congruent to an angle of another and the sides including the angles are _______________, the triangles are similar

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: SSS Similarity Theorem: if the corresponding _______________ _______________ of two triangles are proportional, then the triangles are similar.
Checking SSS: Compare shortest to shortest, _______________ to _______________, then the remaining pair. All the ratios must be _______________.

blocks.stem: Which of the triangles are similar? △ABC has sides 8, 12, 14. △DEF has sides 12, 18, 21. △GHJ has sides 16, 24, 30.

notes: SAS Similarity Theorem: if an angle of one triangle is _______________ to an angle of another and the lengths of the sides _______________ these angles are proportional, then the triangles are similar.

blocks.stem: △ABC has m∠B = 50°, AB = 6, and BC = 9. △DEF has m∠E = 50°, DE = 10, and EF = 15. Are the triangles similar? Explain.
△PQR has PQ = 6, QR = 8, and m∠R = 40°. △STU has ST = 9, TU = 12, and m∠U = 40°. Can you conclude that the triangles are similar?
In △ABC and △DEF, ∠A ≅ ∠D = 72°, AB = 8, AC = 12, DE = 6, and DF = 9. Are the triangles similar? Explain.

tickets.stem: ∠B ≅ ∠E. AB = 5, BC = 7, DE = 15, and EF = 21. Is △ABC ~ △DEF? Explain.
△ABC has sides 3, 4, and 6. △DEF has sides 9, 12, and x + 4. Find x so that the triangles are similar.
